construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Earth directing Water cross-polarity — stability containing depth into productive form
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Steward: current disciplined into irrigation. You manage flows, income streams, schedules, family logistics, with the calm of a well-run canal. Nothing floods, nothing dries. It is unglamorous mastery, and every life around you runs smoother because your channels hold.
candidates.k2_functional: You administer gracefully: systems, budgets, routines that run without drought.

k2_domain_readings.Wealth: Your wealth is flow-managed: salaries channeled, streams diversified, leaks found early. You prosper by routing, not risking. Map the canals once a year and fortune stays irrigated.
k2_domain_readings.Savings: You save in reservoirs: automatic diversions filling quiet pools. Name each pool’s purpose, storm, harvest, joy, and the discipline becomes drinkable.
k2_domain_readings.Steady love: You love in reliable supply: presence delivered daily, needs anticipated, storms weathered by good infrastructure. Choose someone who notices plumbing. Then surprise the schedule occasionally. Even canals enjoy weather.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the current runs thin and every drop has to count. What you build grows slowly and stays built.

angles.drive: You save before you spend, every time. Something put away lets you relax, and you save a little from every month rather than enjoy all of one. You meet a sudden bill with money already set aside.
angles.cost_self: Your calm rests on saving first. You would rather save the money than spend it on yourself, because spending on you feels like a risk. Years pass with the things you wanted for yourself still on the list.
angles.cost_others: Saving first hands your people the careful version of you. You put the savings before the trip together, and give them caution instead of company. The holidays they hoped to take with you stay in the planning.

angles.drive: You sleep on a decision before you make it, even a small one. Waiting a night costs nothing and hurrying costs plenty, so you would rather lose a day than a deal. Few of your choices ever need undoing.
angles.cost_self: Sleeping on a choice keeps your money safe, and it makes you late. You wait a night before saying yes, since a wrong yes costs more than a slow one. Bargains often go to whoever answered while you were still weighing it up.
angles.cost_others: Whenever you sleep on an answer, you leave someone waiting overnight. You would rather be sure tomorrow than quick today, and you hand the wait to whoever asked. Whatever you finally say is something people can build on.

angles.drive: You show up every day the same way, noticed or not. You value being counted on over being exciting, and you show up on dull days too. Whole teams quietly lean on you without saying so.
angles.cost_self: Showing up daily is your way of staying sure of someone. You keep the routine over your rest, since a missed day feels like a crack. Your own plans wait for a gap in a week that has none.
angles.cost_others: What you give the ones you love is that you keep showing up. You hand them presence rather than surprise, and you let them know each day's shape in advance. Life with you is steady and seldom brings anything unexpected.

friction.define: As a friction, more comes at you than feels safe and you close the gate on it. Chances pass by before the water settles.

angles.drive: You hold money back long after holding it back makes sense. Having it in the pool feels safer than having it out, so you hold it rather than use it. Remember that you were after the safety more than the money.
angles.cost_self: Holding back keeps the floor from dropping. You hold money rather than using it even on things you need, because a smaller balance feels like danger. You pay for holding back with the things you needed and never bought.
angles.cost_others: Even with the people closest to you, you hold back first and help second. You would rather keep the account whole than give the full amount asked. For each amount you hold back from them, you take a little ease out of the closeness.

angles.drive: You count the cost before you let yourself want anything. Knowing the price makes a thing safe, so you count what a dinner costs more than what it is worth. Until you count the worth as well, you pay for every dinner without enjoying it.
angles.cost_self: Counting every cost protects you from being caught short. You would rather know what a kindness costs than take it, and you count the free ones too. You miss the closeness that comes from simply letting someone give.
angles.cost_others: With the people you love, you count every cost even on the time you share. You weigh what a night out together costs instead of simply enjoying it. In the end, you hand them your company with the count in plain view.

angles.drive: You wait for the sure thing, and it rarely comes on time. Being certain means more to you than being early, so you wait past the moment for yes. Waiting to be certain, you lose the years a yes would already have given you.
angles.cost_self: Waiting too long keeps you from being wrong. You want the sure yes more than the early one, and you wait until the choice makes itself. Waiting this long, you lose the deals and the people that stopped waiting for you.
angles.cost_others: No matter how close the person asking, you wait to be sure. You put being certain ahead of being there, and you leave them holding the question. By the time you stop waiting, you have already taken the time they needed to plan.

edge.lead: Water runs through your wealth, your family and your career. It is the savings that sit untouched until the bad month comes, the home where the lights stay on without anyone thinking about it, and the work that lands when you said it would.
